summary:
[  edit  ]
The Magnet  SOP  allows you to affect deformations of the input geometry with another object using a "magnetic field" of influence, defined by a metaball field. It allows the creation of animated bumps and dents within objects, and other special effects.
It is important to note that the actual deformation comes from the  Translate  parameters of the Magnet  SOP , and not from the metaball. The metaball defines the area of effect for the  Translate  parameters of the Magnet  SOP . The weight of the metaball determines the effectiveness of the  Translate  within the Magnet  SOP .
The power of the magnet is greatest at the centre of a metaball field and diminishes to nothing at the edge of the field.

parameters.label: Transform Order
parameters.name: xord
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the overall transform order for the transformations. The transform order determines the order in which transformations take place. Depending on the order, you can achieve different results using the exact same values. Choose the appropriate order from the menu.

parameters.label: Rotate Order
parameters.name: rord
parameters.description: ⊞  - Sets the order of the rotations within the overall transform order.

parameters.label: Translate
parameters.name: t
parameters.description: ⊞  - These three fields move the Source geometry in the three axes. The Translates of the metaball only affect the position of the area of influence. The influence itself is provided by an imaginary magnet within the Magnet  SOP  itself, and the attitude of this influence is determined by the Translates of the Magnet  SOP .

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.name: r
parameters.description: ⊞  - These three fields rotate the Source geometry in the three axes.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.name: s
parameters.description: ⊞  - These three fields scale the input geometry in the three axes.

parameters.label: Pivot
parameters.name: p
parameters.description: ⊞  - The pivot point for the transformations. Not the same as the pivot point in the pivot channels.

parameters.label: Affect Position
parameters.name: position
parameters.description: Allow the magnet to affect the position of the input geometry. This is enabled by default.

parameters.label: Affect Point Color
parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Allow the magnet to affect the point color of the input geometry.

parameters.label: Tip:  To control the contribution of each magnet on the surface's Point Color when the  Affect Point Color  option is enabled, set your point colors to black (0,0,0) before the Magnet  SOP  by using a  Point SOP . The Translate fields in the Magnet  SOP  will then add per
parameters.description: point rgb color with values of 2,2,2 approaching white.

parameters.label: Affect Point Normal
parameters.name: nml
parameters.description: Allow the magnet to affect the point normals of the input geometry.

parameters.label: Affect Point Velocity
parameters.name: velocity
parameters.description: Allow the magnet to affect the velocity of the input geometry.

parameters.label: num_points
parameters.description: Number of points in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_prims
parameters.description: Number of primitives in this  SOP .

parameters.label: num_particles
parameters.description: Number of particles in this  SOP .

parameters.label: last_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating geometry data on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: last_meta_vbo_update_time
parameters.description: Time spent in another thread updating meta surface geometry data (such as metaballs or nurbs) on the  GPU  from the  SOP 's CPU data. As it is part of another thread, this time is not part of the usual frame time.

parameters.label: total_cooks
parameters.description: Number of times the operator has cooked since the process started.

parameters.label: cook_time
parameters.description: Duration of the last cook in milliseconds.

parameters.label: cook_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the component timeline.

parameters.label: cook_abs_frame
parameters.description: Frame number when this operator was last cooked relative to the absolute time.

parameters.label: cook_start_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator started cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cook_end_time
parameters.description: Time in milliseconds at which the operator finished cooking in the frame it was cooked.

parameters.label: cooked_this_frame
parameters.description: 1 if operator was cooked this frame.

parameters.label: warnings
parameters.description: Number of warnings in this operator if any.

parameters.label: errors
parameters.description: Number of errors in this operator if any.
